articles.text: SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Duìbuqǐ, duìbuqǐ, ràng nín jiǔ děng le.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I've kept you waiting.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Méi shénme, wǒ láile bú dào shífēn zhōng. Nǐ jiù shi Sūn Zǒnggōngchéngshī ba?
AMERICAN GUEST: That's all right, I've been here less than ten minutes. You must be Chief Engineer Sūn?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Wǒ jiù shi.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: That's right.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Sūn Xiānsheng, hěn zǎo yǐqián wǒ jiù kànguo nínde wénzhāng, nín duì jīxiè gōngyède yánjiū zài guówài shi hěn yǒu míngde. Jīntian néng kàndào nín, kàndào nǐmende chǎng, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
AMERICAN GUEST: Mr. Sūn, I read your writings a long time ago. Your research in the machine industry is very famous abroad. I'm very happy to be able to meet you today and see the factory.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Xièxie nín. Zhèige chǎng shi wǔshí niándài chū jiànlìde.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Thank you. This factory of ours was founded in the early fifties.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Nà shi Xīn Zhōngguó chénglì yǐhòu bù jiǔde shì.
AMERICAN GUEST: Then it wasn't too long after New China was established.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Shìde, shi zài dìyīge wǔnián jìhuàzhōng jiànlìde.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Yes. It was set up during the first five-year plan.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Shi Sūlián bāng nǐmen jiànshède ma?
AMERICAN GUEST: Did the Soviet Union help you construct it?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Bú shi, wánquán shi Zhōngguó rénmín zìjǐ jiànshède. Nèige shíhou zhèngfǔ yòngle liùge yì lái jiànshè zhèige chǎng.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: No, it was constructed completely by the Chinese people themselves. At that time the government spent six hundred million to construct this factory.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Liùge yì?
AMERICAN GUEST: Six hundred million?

SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Liù yì Rénmínbì. Nèige shíhou, wǒmen hěn qióng, Hēilóngjiāng yòu shi yíge biānjiāng dìqū, wǒmen zhēn shi lián qǐmǎde jìshu tiáojiàn dōu méiyǒu. Kěshi zhèige chǎng jiù zài Dǎngde lǐngdǎo hé dàjiāde nǔlì xia, fāzhǎnqilai le.

CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Six hundred million People's Currency. At that time we were very poor, and Hēilóngjiāng being a border region on top of that, we didn't even have the minimum technical conditions. But under the leadership of the Party and with the efforts of everyone, this factory developed.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Tīngshuō zài wǔshí niándài hé liùshí niándài zhèige chǎng zài Zhōngguóde zhòng gōngyèli zhàn hěn zhòngyàode dìwèi. Nèige shíhou, nín zài zhèige chǎng ma?
AMERICAN GUEST: I understand that in the fifties and sixties this factory held an important place in China's heavy industry. Were you here at that time?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Zài. Cóng zhèige chǎng chénglìde nèi yìtiān yìzhí dào Yī jiǔ liù liù nián, wǒ dōu zài zhèige chǎng.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Yes. I was at this factory from the day it was established up until 1966.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Yǐhòu nín líkāi le?
AMERICAN GUEST: And then you left?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Shìde. Yìzhí dào Yī jiǔ qī qī nián wǒ cái huílai.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Right. I didn't come back until 1977.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Tīngshuō nèige shíhou zhèige chǎngde máfan bù shǎo.
AMERICAN GUEST: I hear that at that time this factory had a lot of trouble.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Hēilóngjiāng suīrán bú suàn máfan zuì duōde dìqū, dànshi Yī jiǔ qī qī niánde shíhou zhèige chǎngde shēngchǎn chàbuduō shi cóng líng kāishǐ.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Hēilóngjiāng wasn't one of the regions with the most trouble, but in 1977 this factory had to start production just about from scratch.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Nà yào huā hěn dàde lìliang.
AMERICAN GUEST: That must have taken a great effort.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Yìdiǎnr yě bú cuò. Wǒmen huāle hěn dàde lìliang jiànshè kuàngqū, hé zhèige chǎng. Zài qítāde wèntíshang wǒmen yě yòngle bù shǎode lìliang.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Absolutely. We put a lot of effort into building up mining areas and this factory. We also expended a lot of effort on other problems.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Shénmeyàngde wèntí ne?
AMERICAN GUEST: What kinds of problems?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Dàjiāde shēnghuó wèntí, bǐfang shuō chī fàn wèntí, zhù fángzide wèntí shénmede.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Problems of everyday living — for example eating, housing, and so on.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Xiànzài zěnmeyàng le?
AMERICAN GUEST: And how are things now?
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Zǒngde lái shuō xiànzài dōu gǎode bú cuò le. Wǒ xiǎng zài guò shínián, dào jiǔshí niándài, wǒmen zhèige chǎng huì zài quánguó gōngyè shēngchǎnzhōng zhàn gèng zhòngyàode dìwèi.

CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Generally speaking, things are pretty good now. I think in another ten years, by the nineties, our factory will occupy an even more important position in the nation's industrial production.
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Hǎojíle.
AMERICAN GUEST: That's great.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Xiànzài wǒ jiù péi nín qù cānguān ba, wǒmen yìbiān zǒu yìbiān tán, hǎo bu hǎo?
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: Why don't I show you around now. We can talk as we go, all right?
MĚIGUÓ KÈREN: Hǎo!
AMERICAN GUEST: All right.
SŪN ZǑNGGŌNGCHÉNGSHĪ: Qǐng.
CHIEF ENGINEER SŪN: After you.
